missingKinds.dictionary-key: twin.html reference missing from the frozen en or zh-CN dictionary
missingKinds.zh-only-copy: frozen Chinese-only UI copy with no en variant

skippedKinds.font-metric-ternary: locale-dependent canvas font metric, not user-visible copy
skippedKinds.non-cjk-zh-branch: zh/en literal pair whose Chinese side has no CJK characters
skippedKinds.expression-branch: locale-conditioned ternary with a non-literal or concatenated branch
skippedKinds.nested-ternary: locale-conditioned ternary whose Chinese branch is itself a ternary
skippedKinds.non-literal-branch: locale-conditioned ternary whose branches are variable references
skippedKinds.grouped-array: grouped option arrays whose zh/en text fields do not align

rules.dictionary: js/translations.js executed in node:vm; only the en and zh-CN maps are read and emitted.
rules.static: every data-i18n, data-i18n-html, data-i18n-title, data-i18n-aria-label, data-i18n-placeholder and data-i18n-lbl attribute in twin.html, aggregated by key; no nine-locale arrays are copied.
rules.namedPair: literal zh/en property pairs (nameZh/nameEn, bayName/bayNameZh, statusTextZh/statusTextEn) or member assignments within four source lines; concatenated values are excluded.
rules.ternary: Chinese-language condition (isZh, currentLang or lang === zh-CN/zh-TW, .startsWith("zh"), negated and en variants) with two plain literal branches; zh is the true branch unless the condition is negated; template interpolation expressions are kept verbatim.
rules.zhOnlyCopy: showTwinToast calls with a Chinese literal and no locale ternary are recorded in missing with kind zh-only-copy.
rules.skipped: locale-conditioned ternaries this inventory cannot pair (font metrics, non-literal branches, nested ternaries) are listed in skipped, never silently dropped.
